I saw some of the shelter residents stuck a little further in, so I'm gonna head forward and free them first.
I'm counting on you to keep the rest of the set safe.
I'll check in when I can. Stay tuned.

...Why was that one of the easier things I've done today?

I haven't seen the others.

By the way, would you go check the upper area once the flames have been put out?
I think it'll be fine, but there's always a chance the sprinklers kicked on before all of the Genesect were finished dying.
We'll head out of here soon.

I've just barely been keeping distance from these two while I've been trapped in here.

HARDY: I get the feeling you'll know what to do with it.

She took out a bunch of those things?
That's my girl!
Still, I'mma find her!
Peace!

AYA: All right?
I just had the world's shittiest rehearsal interrupted by my abusive stepdad,
Ran out, found him and everyone else spirited into dust,
Followed them to find a secret dark factory overlapping onto the real world full of aggressive mutant cyborg bugs,
Which I then had to fight by the dozen, and proceeded to burn them all to a crisp.
I am NOT "all right".
I'm fucking great.
And you are lucky that I was here to save you!

...Rock on, girl.

No matter what gets in the way...

Do your worst to take her from me.

I'll just, um...

EVE: ...Ugh.
EVE: There's too much to be done already, and obviously I need to go talk to her now too.
\PN, can I ask for your help again, even after all this?
This New World environment is exactly what I've been waiting for-- for a number of reasons.
The first reason is that I've confirmed that multiple Shaymin live here.
I'll explain the rest later, but I need you to collect several of them.
Let's say five in total should do.
If you can bring them back here, that should be adequate.
I'll go... talk to her.
We'll come to an understanding, don't worry.
Back soon--
Five Shaymin! Please!

Your help is irreplaceable as always; thank you.
As for Lumi, she'll be fine.
She's agreed to cooperate, but as a precautionary compromise, she'll be waiting elsewhere until the very moment we need her.
For now, we can continue.
Our next step will be to remove the anomalous energy around these Shaymin.
My opinion is that this energy is something like leftover, junk material from the generation of these worlds and their Pokémon.
It appears to collect around the most powerful figures in these worlds like debris falling into a planet's orbit.
Depending on the amount of leftover material, it may or may not form into a proper aura, but even when it doesn't--
EVE: ...It doesn't mean it's not there.
Here, I've linked the energies of all five of the Shaymin with each other to accentuate the anomalous energy and develop it into a tangible form.
This will allow us to deal with it directly in the usual way.
You know, witless violence and all that.
By purging the aura ahead of time, we'll be preventing any unexpected interferences.
I'd like to take no chances, thank you.
Now, I believe that violence is your specialty, so I'd like to ask you again to help with the honors.
Allow me to heal your party now as apology for before...
